numberPrefix.title: Order number prefix
numberPrefix.description: Put before every order number (for example IM-). Order numbers are <prefix><year>-<number> by your business time zone's year.

messageChannels.title: Order messages by
messageChannels.description: How shoppers get order messages, through Notifications.

notifyStatuses.title: Statuses that send a message
notifyStatuses.description: Status keys of your order flow; moving an order into one of them sends the shopper a message.

policyFormat.title: Policy format
policyFormat.description: Plain text, or HTML (paragraphs, lists, headings, bold, italic, underline, quotes and links).

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods offered
paymentMethods.description: Online payment and bank transfer go through Payments (paste its token in Connections); pay at pickup needs a pickup location. Cash on delivery is its own feature.

paymentWindowMinutes.title: Time to pay (minutes)
paymentWindowMinutes.description: An order paid online or by bank transfer (or a cash-on-delivery advance) that is not paid within this time is cancelled and its stock given back. 0 = never cancelled.

confirmationHours.title: Time to confirm (hours)
confirmationHours.description: A cash-on-delivery or pay-at-pickup order your staff do not confirm within this time is cancelled and its stock given back. 0 = never cancelled.

openOrderCap.title: Waiting orders per customer
openOrderCap.description: A customer may have at most this many orders waiting for payment or confirmation (0 = no limit).

addressRequired.title: Required address fields
addressRequired.description: Besides the name and phone. Leave out the city for one free-text address.

guests.title: Guest checkout
guests.description: off: shoppers sign in to order. on: anyone orders with a name and phone. unless_password: a phone that belongs to a member with a password must sign in (checked with Accounts).

defaultCallingCode.title: Default calling code
defaultCallingCode.description: For guest phones typed without one, for example +92.

trunkPrefix.title: Trunk prefix
trunkPrefix.description: Dropped from national numbers before the calling code, for example 0.

customerRecords.title: Customers appear
customerRecords.description: first_order: a customer record is made with their first order (or when staff open an Accounts user). sign_in: also as soon as a signed-in shopper uses the shop, before any order.

paymentOrder.title: Payment methods order
paymentOrder.description: The order the cart lists them; the first available is preselected.

successUrl.title: Success page
successUrl.description: Where shoppers return after placing or paying, with {number} and {id}. Empty = the page they ordered from with ss_order.

cancelUrl.title: Payment cancelled page
cancelUrl.description: Where shoppers return when they leave a payment, with {number} and {id}. Empty = as the success page.

bankTransferVia.title: Bank transfers
bankTransferVia.description: payments: through Payments' bank page. manual: the order waits for the shopper's proof and staff record the payment.

autoRefundedStatus.title: Refunded status when fully refunded
autoRefundedStatus.description: Move an order to the refunded status once its refunds reach what was paid.

returnRestock.title: Returned orders go back to stock

shopperCancel.title: Shoppers may cancel in
shopperCancel.description: Roles of statuses in which shoppers may cancel their own order.

paidOnConfirm.title: Paid when staff confirm
paidOnConfirm.description: Payment methods whose orders count as paid when staff move them out of waiting (for example a bank transfer checked by hand): the balance is recorded as a payment of that method, and an open Payments payment is cancelled. Empty = staff record payments themselves.

statusTemplates.title: Status messages
statusTemplates.description: one: one template for every status. per_status: ecommerce.order_status.<status key> per status.

orderUrl.title: Order page address
orderUrl.description: For messages, with {number}, for example https://shop.com/orders/{number}.
